flexibledodge.configuration.title: Flexible Dodge Configs
config.flexibledodge.dodgeInvulnerabilit: Dodge invulnerability frames duration in seconds. Default: 0.2. If longer than the dodge's movement duration it is clamped to end with the movement.
config.flexibledodge.dodgeSpeed.tooltip: Dodge movement speed in blocks per second. Default: 10.0.
config.flexibledodge.dodgeDistance.toolt: Dodge distance in blocks. Default: 1.0. This is the geometric-decay total; the actual dash travels slightly more (about 1.4 blocks at 1.0) because the initial pulse and the following tick are both applied at peak speed. With dodgeSpeed it determines the dodge duration.
config.flexibledodge.dodgeCooldownStep.t: Cooldown step per consecutive dodge in seconds: the 1st dodge has no cooldown, each following dodge adds this amount up to the cap. Measured from the moment the previous dodge's movement fully ended. Default: 0.1.
config.flexibledodge.dodgeCooldownMax.to: Upper bound of the consecutive dodge cooldown in seconds. Default: 0.6.
config.flexibledodge.dodgeCooldownResetT: Dodging more than this many seconds after the previous dodge's movement ended restarts the cooldown ramp from the 1st dodge. Default: 2.0.
Show the dodge indicator markers (< >, and <<< >>> for a perfect dodge). Default: true.
config.flexibledodge.dodgeMarkerTime.too: Dodge indicator marker duration in seconds. How long the < > markers stay visible. Default: 0.2.
config.flexibledodge.dodgeCooldownBarEna: Show the dodge cooldown bar below the crosshair (translucent, styled after the vanilla attack indicator and crosshair). Default: true.
config.flexibledodge.dodgeCooldownBarFla: Duration of the full-bar flash shown on a perfect dodge, in seconds. Default: 0.15.
